description: This file is a PHPUnit test case class for the BuzzPost entity within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It sets up test data, mocks dependencies like DateTimeHelperService, and tests the creation and properties of a BuzzPost object, including timestamps and associated employee information.

classes.name: BuzzPostTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the BuzzPost entity, involving data setup, dependency mocking, and validation of entity properties and timestamp handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares test environment by loading fixture data and truncating BuzzPost table.

methods.name: testEntity
methods.description: Tests the creation of a BuzzPost entity, setting properties, mocking current time, and validating entity attributes.
